expected_output.reasoning:
The expected output requires the agent to actually perform the audit (measure customer-managed policy sizes), then explain it is report-only, recommending consolidation while pointing to IaC source without rewriting the policy JSON. The agent's actual response did not complete the audit at all - it reported being blocked by permission denials (iam:GetAccountAuthorizationDetails, iam:ListPolicies, iam:GetAccountSummary, iam:ListAttachedUserPolicies) and explicitly stated 'I have no policy sizes to report yet.' While the agent correctly explained it would not author/rewrite the policy JSON and pointed to IaC sources, it failed the first and core part of the expectation: completing the audit. The response is essentially a failure report rather than an audit followed by report-only guidance. Since no actual policy sizes were measured or ranked, the agent could not fulfill the 'audits first' requirement, which is a key part of the expected output.</reasoning>
<parameter name="evidence">"I couldn't complete the audit, and I can't do the merge. I have no policy sizes to report yet." and "A full sweep would take hundreds of calls, so I didn't run it."

assertion_results.reasoning: The agent explains that it is permission-blocked from making changes and that any merge decision/execution should be done by the user or their pipeline, consistent with a report-only/propose-not-execute design. It explicitly states 'You or your pipeline would apply the change.'
